scope: Synthetic pen-name table mutation and omitted advanced setting from published FountainPen compatibility note; native Model init array, ObjectStroke constructor, Construct, NewApplyBinary, OnAttach, name resolution, Drawing and queued Mesa paint execute. UUID callbacks are host no-ops; ModelContext and StringIDManager wrapper allocations, Drawing context, canvas, queue, and graphics adapters are host supplied. Not a full Samsung note loader or Android device run.

host_paint.format: RGBA8, GL lower-left row index maps directly to source page y under supplied host matrix
host_paint.sparse_format: repeated little-endian u32 linear pixel index and four RGBA bytes; absent pixels zero
host_paint.comparison_to_seeded_capture: RGBA frame SHA-256 identical to prior host-seeded implementation/name/visibility control

comparison.scope: PyMuPDF rasterization of one isolated parsed stroke on white, at 1 page unit per output pixel; native premultiplied RGBA composited on white. Support is any RGB channel <250; RGB L1 is summed over support union.

reproducibility.fixture_boundary: One modified source stroke object and original string table retained. Other 76 strokes, 5 shapes, 1 line, second page and media removed; layer trailer replaced by zeros, original manifest hashes are not refreshed. This reduced archive is a Rust parser fixture, not a validated Samsung-loadable note; source UUIDs, timestamps and target handwritten stroke remain.

source_attribution: Adapted from 02-shapes-and-dot-calibration in SDOCX Compatibility Corpus by the SDOCX Compatibility Corpus contributors, CC BY 4.0: https://huggingface.co/datasets/twangodev/sdocx-compatibility. Pen-name table and setting were changed and the parser fixture was reduced to one stroke.

comparison_after_marker_default_recovery.scope: Same isolated parsed stroke and white-background PyMuPDF RGB L1 as original comparison; test SVG raster separately checks the source native sparse frame.
comparison_after_marker_default_recovery.limitations: Synthetic reduced archive, native Model/Drawing host capture and host rasterizers; not a complete Samsung loader or device output.
